ja244:1.1: What he sees he does not desire, but that
ja244:1.2: Which he does not see he desires, it seems.
ja244:1.3: I think he will wander for a long time,
ja244:1.4: But he will not find that which he desires.
ja244:2.1: What he has he isn’t satisfied by that,
ja244:2.2: What he wishes for, received, he condemns,
ja244:2.3: For his desires know no bounded limits,
ja244:2.4: I must revere the one without desire.
